name: the-blockchain-library
description: Open-source blockchain knowledge platform and structured Knowledge Engine.

scripts.build:knowledge: npm run validate:knowledge && npm run generate:knowledge
scripts.build:expanded: npm run validate:expanded && npm run generate:expanded
scripts.build:platform: npm run validate:expanded && npm run validate:platform && npm run generate:platform && npm run generate:coverage
scripts.build:v2: npm run validate:base44 && npm run compile:base44
scripts.distribute:v2: npm run generate:mintlify && npm run generate:release && npm run validate:distribution && npm run validate:docs
scripts.release:knowledge: npm run build:v2 && npm run distribute:v2
scripts.sync:base44: npm run pull:base44 && npm run release:knowledge
scripts.check: npm run build:knowledge && npm run build:expanded && npm run build:platform && npm run distribute:v2
